document.name: The Bronx Museum — Family Time
document.shortDescription: Free monthly Saturday family art-making at The Bronx Museum on Grand Concourse, with drop-ins welcome and activities designed for all ages.
document.longDescription:
The Bronx Museum's Family Programs page describes free art-making activities inspired by exhibitions on view in the galleries, designed and facilitated by Bronx Museum educators. The museum says these activities are fun for all ages, accessible to families with young children, and open to drop-ins.

The museum's current Family Time event page lists the next session as Saturday, June 13, 2026 from 1:00-3:00 PM at 1040 Grand Concourse in the Bronx. The same page says Family Time is free, for all ages and skill levels, and drop-in only with no RSVP needed. It also states that one Saturday afternoon per month the museum offers free art-making for all ages as part of its Family Programs.

The museum's main site lists the venue as 1040 Grand Concourse, Bronx, NY 10456 with phone 718-681-6000. Questions for the Family Time program are directed to education@bronxmuseum.org, and the homepage notes that admission is always free for everyone.

Sources: https://bronxmuseum.org/learn/family-programs/ https://bronxmuseum.org/event/family-time-june26/ https://bronxmuseum.org/
